title: Errol Eats Everything and Blu take listeners "Beyond Yonder [Furious Evans Remix]" on a ride
htmlContent: Errol Eats Everything is back with a new take on his soundscape. He got LA rapper Blu to do the lead remix of "Beyond Yonder [Furious Evans Remix]." Blu is known for his sharp lyrics and old-school hip-hop style. He brings a raw, introspective energy to the song that both honours and changes Errol's original vision. The remix has a good mix of electronic sounds that make you want to dance and lyrics that make you think. The official video for the Blu remix takes the song to a whole new level, paying homage to the Blade Vampire Tales movies in a stylised way. Dark, moody images mix with Errol's rhythmic layers and Blu's strong verses to make a story that feels both futuristic and eerily timeless. People who like music with sharp lyrics and stories will love the audio-visual journey, where every beat and bar builds up a lot of tension. https://open.spotify.com/track/2qMsB03myC9ajkmz5yYTET This release is the first look at Errol Eats Everything's upcoming Remix EP, which will feature many great artists, including Rome Streets, Planet Asia, Brother Ali, and Don Von Jovi. The EP looks like it will be a mix of different styles and influences, with "Beyond Yonder [Furious Evans Remix]" being the best song that hints at the adventurous spirit of what's to come. Errol Eats Everything featuring Blu on "Beyond Yonder [Furious Evans Remix]" is a must-listen for anyone who wants a mix of deep lyrics, punchy electronic production, and a cinematic feel. This remix changes what a collaborative track can feel like in 2025. Follow Errol Eats Everything on Instagram and Facebook
